columns.alien_template|signalclassification|sign: Unique signal ID, format 'AS' plus 6 digits, padded with spaces to 36 chars. One per row.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|sigc: Category of signal origin. One of: Artificial, Natural, Candidate, Unknown. Text length 7-10.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|sigp: Temporal pattern label. One of: Structured, Random, Unknown, Periodic. Text length 6-10.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|repe: Integer count of signal repetitions. Values 0 to 99. Higher means more repeats.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|peri: Measured period duration. Real number, typical format DDDDD.DD, values around 10000 to 86000 seconds.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|comp: Numeric complexity score. Values 0.001 to 1.0. Higher means more complex. Format D.DDD.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|entr: Shannon entropy of signal. Values 0.0 to 7.99. Higher means more random or unpredictable.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|info: Information density score. Values 0.002 to 0.999. Fraction-like measure of information content.
columns.alien_template|signalclassification|clas: Confidence percentage for assigned signal class. Values 0.0 to 99.9. Higher means more confident.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|signalref: Always 36 characters in the form 'AS' followed by six digits and trailing spaces to fill the length. Each record has a distinct value, used to reference a specific signal.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|analysisp: One of Low, Medium, High, or Urgent. Indicates the priority of analysis work and contains no null values.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|followsta: Indicates follow-up state as Required, Scheduled, or Completed. Values are one of these three statuses, each 8 to 9 characters long.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|peerrevst: Current peer review state: Pending, In Progress, or Completed. Values are one of these three statuses, ranging from 7 to 11 characters.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|pubstat: Publication state: Draft, Submitted, or Published. Values are padded to 25 characters with trailing spaces and contain one of these three statuses.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|resprio: Priority assigned to research work: Low, Medium, or High. Values range from 3 to 6 characters with no null values.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|fundstat: Funding state: Pending, Unfunded, or Funded. Values are padded to 30 characters with trailing spaces and contain one of these three statuses.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|collabsta: Collaboration mode: Team, International, or Solo. Values are padded to 35 characters with trailing spaces and contain one of these three statuses.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|secclass: Security level: Public, Restricted, or Classified. Values are padded to 35 characters with trailing spaces and contain one of these three levels.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|discstat: Disclosure level: Full or Partial. Non-null values are one of these two statuses; 326 records have no value.
columns.alien_template|researchprocess|notesmemo: Contains arbitrary sentence-like notes, mostly unique per record. Values are 12 to 64 characters long; 492 records have no value.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|signa: Format is AS followed by six digits, then spaces to 36 characters. Unique per row.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|false: Real number with 1 to 3 decimal places. Values range from 0.001 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|sigun: Real number with 1 to 3 decimal places. Values range from 0.001 to 0.999.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|simin: Real number with 1 to 3 decimal places. Values range from 0.001 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|corrs: Real number with optional leading minus sign and up to 3 decimal places. Values range from -0.003 to 0.989.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|anoms: Numeric score with 0 to 3 decimal places. Values include integers and fractions from 0 to 1.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|techs: Real number with 1 to 3 decimal places. Values range from 0.001 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|biosi: Real number with 2 to 3 decimal places. Values range from 0.0 to 1.0, often coarse steps.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|natsr: Real number with 2 to 3 decimal places. Values range from 0.002 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|artsr: Real number with one decimal place. Values are multiples of 0.1 from 0.0 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signals|signalregistry: Unique 36-character identifier. Pattern AADDDDDD followed by spaces. Every row has distinct value.
columns.alien_template|signals|timemark: 29-character timestamp format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.microseconds+08. Values unique, span 2015-2025.
columns.alien_template|signals|telescref: 20-character identifier, pattern ADDDD then spaces. Mostly unique, some duplicate refs.
columns.alien_template|signals|detectinstr: One of four categories: Optical Telescope, Radio Telescope, Infrared Array, Quantum Detector. Text lengths 14-17.
columns.alien_template|signals|signalclass: One of five classes: Broadband, Continuous, Pulsed, Narrowband, Modulated.
columns.alien_template|signals|sigstrdb: Negative decimal values with one or two decimal places. Usually around -99 to -125 dB.
columns.alien_template|signals|freqmhz: Positive numeric frequency. Unique per row, values roughly 10,000 to 99,900 MHz, with up to three decimals.
columns.alien_template|signals|bwhz: Numeric bandwidth from 0.31 to 999.81 Hz. Values have one or two decimal places, mostly unique.
columns.alien_template|signals|centerfreqmhz: Numeric center frequency. Unique per row, values around 10,000 to 99,800 MHz.
columns.alien_template|signals|freqdrifthzs: Decimal numeric drift. Values span about -0.009 to 9.99 Hz.
columns.alien_template|signals|doppshifthz: Numeric Doppler shift, observed -10.24 to 996.23. Values use decimals despite INTEGER type.
columns.alien_template|signals|sigdursec: Numeric duration, values roughly from under 1000 to above 3500 seconds. Mostly unique.
columns.alien_template|signals|pulsewidms: Decimal width in ms, 0.37 to 999.89. Mostly unique.
columns.alien_template|signals|modtype: One of AM, FM, PM, QAM, or Unknown.
columns.alien_template|signals|modindex: Decimal value between 0.0 and 1.0, typically three decimal places. Some repeated values.
columns.alien_template|signals|carrierfreqmhz: Numeric frequency, unique per row. Values around 10,000 to 99,900 MHz.
columns.alien_template|signals|phaseshiftdeg: Decimal degrees, values from about 0 to 345.8. Positive values, one or two decimals.
columns.alien_template|signals|polarmode: One of Linear, Unknown, Circular, Elliptical.
columns.alien_template|signals|polarangledeg: Decimal degrees, observed about 0.1 to 152.7. Positive values.
columns.alien_template|signals|snrratio: Decimal SNR values, include negatives and positives. Roughly -18.8 to 39.5.
columns.alien_template|signals|noisefloordbm: Negative decimal values, around -100 to -104 dBm.
columns.alien_template|signals|interflvl: TEXT with values Low, Medium, High. 235 nulls. Non-null counts: 270 Medium, 250 Low, 245 High.
columns.alien_template|signals|rfistat: One of three statuses. Non-null all rows: 356 Unknown, 331 Contaminated, 313 Clean.
columns.alien_template|signals|atmointerf: One of three categories. Non-null all rows: 364 Minimal, 324 Moderate, 312 Severe.
columns.alien_template|observationalconditions|s: Unique signal reference code with prefix 'AS' followed by six digits, right-padded to 36 characters with spaces.
columns.alien_template|observationalconditions|o: Time of observation in HH:MM:SS format. All values in this sample are '00:00:00'.
Date of observation in YYYY-MM-DD format, ranging from 2015-02-23 to 2025-02-09.
Duration of observation as a decimal number of hours, ranging from 0.01 to 9.93 in this sample.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|signalre: 36-character fixed-width code: 'AS' followed by 6 digits and trailing spaces. One unique value per row.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|sourcera: Numeric decimal degrees, format DDD.DDDD or DD.DDDD. Values cover full circle; common examples include 359.9213 and 357.7387.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|sourcede: Numeric decimal degrees, can be negative. Values span about -90 to +90; common examples include 68.3382 and 89.8432.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|sourcedi: Numeric light-year value with decimal places. Values are large, around 100000 to 999000; format DDDDDD.DD.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|gallong: Numeric degrees, format DDD.DD or DD.DD. Values range 0 to 360; common examples include 358.91 and 301.33.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|gallat: Numeric degrees, can be negative. Values span about -90 to +90; common examples include 72.72 and -82.53.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|celestob: Category text with one of four values: Galaxy, Star, Planet, Unknown. String length 4 to 7.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objtype: Category text with one of four values: Dwarf, Giant, Main Sequence, Unknown. String length 5 to 13, includes spaces.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objmag: Numeric decimal magnitude, can be negative. Format patterns DD.DD or -DD.DD; examples include 19.97 and -15.96.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objtempk: Integer temperature value. Values are in thousands to tens of thousands; common examples include 48337 and 14696.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objmasss: Numeric decimal mass value. Values range roughly 0.166 to 99.852; format D.DDD to DD.DDD.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objagegy: Numeric decimal age value. Values range roughly 0.026 to 13.461 Gyr; format D.DD to DD.DDD.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objmetal: Numeric decimal metallicity, can be negative. Values range roughly -2.962 to 0.998; common examples include -0.469 and 0.497.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objpropm: Numeric decimal proper motion. Values are below 10; format D.D, D.DD, or DD.D; common examples include 7.7 and 3.87.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|objradve: Numeric decimal radial velocity, can be negative. Values range roughly -0.63 to 997.91; format DD.DD to DDD.DD.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|s: Always 36 characters: 'AS' followed by 6 digits then spaces to fill. 1000 unique values in 1000 records; no nulls. Example 'AS100974'.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|i: One of three ordered categories: 'Minimal' (357), 'Moderate' (329), 'Severe' (314). Always non-null, length 6-8.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|g: Only two values: 'Strong' (347) and 'Weak' (320); 333 nulls. Value length 4-6.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|q: Only two values: 'Observed' (340) and 'Significant' (314); 346 nulls. Value length 8 or 11.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|e: Only two values: 'Strong' (350) and 'Possible' (311); 339 nulls. Value length 6 or 8.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|l: Only two values: 'Complex' (356) and 'Simple' (309); 335 nulls. Value length 7 or 6.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|m: Only two values: 'Identified' (360) and 'Possible' (336); 304 nulls. Value length 10 or 8.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|c: Only two values: 'High' (332) and 'Low' (322); 346 nulls. Value length 4 or 3.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|s: One of three categories: 'Moderate' (338), 'Major' (332), 'Minor' (330). Always non-null, value length 5-8.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|signalref: Format 'AS' + six digits + trailing spaces to 36 chars. Unique per record; 1000 distinct values.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|encodetype: One of four encoding labels. No nulls; counts: Unknown 267, Tertiary 249, Complex 246, Binary 238.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|compressra: Real value from 1.0 to 9.97. No nulls; 614 distinct values. Format examples: D.D, D.DD.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|errcorrlvl: Nullable. Three non-null labels: Low 250, High 248, Medium 237. Values: High, Medium, Low.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|decodeconf: Real value from 0.2 to 99.8. No nulls; 627 distinct. Format examples: DD.D, D.D.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|decodemeth: Four method labels. No nulls; counts: FFT 267, Wavelet 259, Neural Network 239, Quantum 235.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|decodestat: Three status labels. No nulls; counts: In Progress 345, Completed 343, Failed 312.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|decodeiter: Integer count of decoding iterations. No nulls; 637 distinct values. Range roughly 1 to 1000, e.g. 829, 536, 2.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|proctimehr: Real value from 10.22 to 998.72. No nulls; 993 distinct. Format examples: DDD.DD, DDD.D, DD.DD.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|compresour: Four resource labels. No nulls; counts: Low 274, Medium 269, Extreme 233, High 224.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|analysisdp: Three analysis depth levels. No nulls; counts: Preliminary 344, Detailed 336, Comprehensive 320.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|veriflvl: Three verification levels. No nulls; counts: Unverified 340, Partially 335, Verified 325.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|confirmsta: Three confirmation status labels. No nulls; counts: Rejected 370, Confirmed 317, Pending 313.
columns.alien_template|observatories|observstati: Unique observatory name, padded with spaces to 60 chars. Format: 'Observatory-<PlaceName>' with trailing spaces; 963 distinct values, one per record.
columns.alien_template|observatories|weathprofil: Weather profile describing sky cover; one of three fixed values. Length 5-16 chars.
columns.alien_template|observatories|seeingprofi: Seeing profile category; one of three fixed values. Length 4-9 chars.
columns.alien_template|observatories|atmostransp: Numeric transparency value from 0.0 to 1.0; one or two decimal places. 101 distinct values; patterns D.D and D.DD.
columns.alien_template|observatories|lunarstage: Lunar phase stage; one of four fixed values. Length 3-13 chars.
columns.alien_template|observatories|lunardistde: Numeric lunar distance in degrees; one or two decimal places. Many distinct values; patterns D.DD to DDD.DD.
columns.alien_template|observatories|solarstatus: Solar status category; one of three fixed values. Length 3-8 chars.
columns.alien_template|observatories|geomagstatu: Geomagnetic status category; one of three fixed values. Length 5-6 chars.
columns.alien_template|observatories|siderealloc: Sidereal local time stored as text, 8 chars with trailing spaces. Values like '2.8145  ', '17.5037 '; patterns D.DDDD, DD.DDDD.
columns.alien_template|observatories|airtempc: Numeric air temperature in degrees Celsius; one decimal place. Values include negative and positive readings, e.g., -8.7 to 36.4.
columns.alien_template|observatories|humidityrat: Numeric relative humidity percentage; one decimal place. Values from 0.0 to 99.9; patterns D.D and DD.D.
columns.alien_template|observatories|windspeedms: Numeric wind speed in m/s; one decimal place. Values range from 0.0 to 22.2; patterns D.D and DD.D.
columns.alien_template|observatories|presshpa: Numeric barometric pressure in hPa; one decimal place. Common values roughly 980-1028 hPa; patterns DDD.D and DDDD.D.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|signalref: Unique signal reference code. Always 36 chars, pattern AS followed by 6 digits. Values range AS100974 to AS999544. One per record.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigintegri: Signal integrity value as percentage. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns DD.D, D.D, DDD.D. High value means stronger integrity.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigrecurr: Categorical signal recurrence. Values are 'Regular' or 'Sporadic'. 331 NULLs out of 1000. Text length 7 or 8 chars.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigevolve: Categorical signal evolution. Three values: Static (351), Dynamic (339), Unknown (310). Text length 6 or 7 chars.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|tempstab: Temporal stability value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more stability.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|spatstab: Spatial stability value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more stability.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|freqstab: Frequency stability value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more stability.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|phasestab: Phase stability value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more stability.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|ampstab: Amplitude stability value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more stability.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|modstab: Modulation stability value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more stability.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigcoheren: Signal coherence value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more coherence.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigdisp: Signal dispersion amount. Stored as text, 3-6 chars. Patterns DDD.DD, DD.DD, DDD.D, D.DD, DD.D. Mostly unique values.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigscint: Signal scintillation value. Stored as text, 3-5 chars. Patterns D.DDD, D.DD, D.D. Higher value indicates more scintillation.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|telescregistry: Unique ID string, pattern T followed by digits, padded to 20 chars. Example: T1000.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|observstation: Station name format 'Observatory-<Name>', padded to 60 chars. Example: Observatory-New Michael.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|equipstatus: Status value: Maintenance, Degraded, or Operational.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|calibrstatus: Calibration currency: Current, Due, or Overdue.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|pointaccarc: Pointing accuracy real number, range 0.01-9.99 arcsec. Values like 5.24.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|trackaccarc: Tracking accuracy real number, range 0.01-9.98 arcsec. Values like 6.98.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|focusquality: Rating of focus: Excellent, Good, or Poor.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|detecttempk: Detector temperature in Kelvin, real value, range 0.25-99.81. Values like 290.78.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|coolsysstatus: Cooling system status: Critical, Warning, or Normal.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|powerstatus: Power status: Main, Backup, or Critical.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|datastorstatus: Data storage status: Critical, Low, or Available.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|netstatus: Network status: Connected, Limited, or Disconnected.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|bandusagepct: Bandwidth usage percentage, real number, range 0.0-99.9. Values like 47.6.
columns.alien_template|telescopes|procqueuestatu: Processing queue status: Full, Normal, or Empty.
